retrievalProfile.description: A layered collage featuring a central geographic silhouette over a cosmic or map-textured circular backdrop with high-contrast metallic and script typography.
triggerTerms: metallic beveled text over cosmic globe
geographic cutout collage with notebook elements

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition characterized by a central white geographic silhouette (Texas) superimposed on a circular cosmic/nebula background. The design utilizes high-contrast textures including lightning, maps, and notebook paper, framed by bold, metallic-effect display type and elegant script accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Geographic silhouette as the primary focal point and negative space anchor
Circular cosmic background providing depth and color contrast
Metallic display type framing the top corners
Script and sans-serif typography anchoring the bottom third
coreInvariants: Deep purple and blue cosmic/nebula textures

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large white geographic silhouette centered, occupying 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white shape acts as a stark anchor against the dark, busy background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top metallic text, drop to the central white shape, and finish at the script text and notebook detail at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The central silhouette serves as functional negative space, creating a 'hole' in the busy texture.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white (central silhouette and text highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright white foreground elements.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses heavy vertical strokes and thin horizontals
Metallic beveling and inner glows applied to large headers
Script text features long, flowing descenders and ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are often stretched vertically to fill corner spaces
Drop shadows are used to separate text from complex textures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact metallic serifs paired with delicate, airy scripts for a 'street-luxury' contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the high-contrast serif skeleton needed for the metallic headers.
Captures the elegant, flourished look of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark purple and indigo cosmic nebula background inside a circular frame, overlaid with faint map textures and electric lightning strikes. Place a large, solid white silhouette of a geographic region (like Texas) in the center. Add a spiral notebook corner in the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, vertically-stretched metallic-beveled serif text in the top corners. Add a flowing white script line in the lower third, followed by a spaced-out sans-serif line at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the central silhouette stark white?
Does the background have a cosmic/nebula texture?
Is the top text metallic and beveled?
Is there a script font present in the lower third?

adjustableVariables: Background color (e.g., red/orange for different mood)
mustRedesign: Exact map details of the region

mustAchieve: Visible metallic texture on display type
High contrast between white center and dark edges

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic beveling on headers
Ensure the central shape remains a solid, untextured white
Verify the presence of the circular background boundary
Confirm the script text is legible against the dark background
recipe.reuseFormula: Central [Geographic Shape] + Circular [Cosmic/Map Texture] + Metallic [Serif Header] + White [Script Subtitle]
